commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f"
python3 scripts/diagnose_architecture.py --markdown

set -u
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-audit3-venv-XXXXXX)
DATA=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-audit3-data-XXXXXX)
STORAGE=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-audit3-storage-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV" "$DATA" "$STORAGE"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV" || exit 1
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt || exit 1
export PHOTOMAP_DATA_DIR="$DATA" PHOTOMAP_STORAGE_DIR="$STORAGE" ADMIN_TOKEN=dev-admin-token CLAIM_TOKEN_SECRET=audit-claim-secret
run(){ printf '\n=== %s ===\n' "$1"; shift; "$@"; code=$?; printf 'EXIT=%s\n' "$code"; return 0; }
run backend-ruff-check "$VENV/bin/python" -m ruff check backend/app server.py scripts
run backend-pytest bash -lc "cd backend && '$VENV/bin/python' -m pytest -q"
run schema-check "$VENV/bin/python" scripts/check_schema.py
run css-token-gate "$VENV/bin/python" scripts/quality/css_token_gate.py
run frontend-format bash -lc 'cd frontend && npm run format:check'
run frontend-lint bash -lc 'cd frontend && npm run lint'
run frontend-knip bash -lc 'cd frontend && npm run knip'
run frontend-unit bash -lc 'cd frontend && npm run test'
run frontend-build bash -lc 'cd frontend && npm run build'
printf '\n=== FINAL STATUS ===\n'
git diff --check
git status --short
trap - EXIT
rm -rf "$VENV" "$DATA" "$STORAGE"
./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
